{{Quote|This is my first time commanding a squadron, R7. Let's make a good impression.|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
'''R7-A7''' was an [[astromech droid]] who belonged to [[Ahsoka Tano]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], he served in the astromech socket of her various [[starfighter]]s whenever she flew in combat. R7 remained loyal to Tano after her departure from the [[Jedi Order]], and assisted her alongside astromech droids [[CH-33P]] and [[RG-G1]] when she found herself on the run from [[clone trooper]]s after the issuance of [[Order 66]], including capturing [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex]] to remove his [[behavioral modification biochip]]. R7 was destroyed by [[blaster]] fire when Tano and Rex were [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|fighting]] other clones in the [[hangar]] of the crashing [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]'', but Tano and Rex salvaged his remains from the wreckage. The droid was subsequently rebuilt and ended up in the possession of the [[Martez family|Martez sisters]], two [[smuggler]]s and friends of Tano who were working against the [[Galactic Empire]] as part of [[Clone Underground|Rex's resistance network]].

==Biography==
===Clone Wars===
====Battle of Ryloth====
[[File:Blue_Leader_at_Battle_of_Ryloth.png|thumb|left|279x279px|R7 as Tano's copilot during the Battle of Ryloth]]
R7-A7's first mission was serving in the [[Battle of Ryloth]] as co-[[pilot]] of [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter|Jedi starfighter]]. He flew with her on a mission to take out the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Ryloth blockade|blockade]] surrounding [[Ryloth]], and was present when she disobeyed orders to retreat after Separatist reinforcements arrived, losing most of her [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)|squadron]]. After the ''[[Resolute]]'' and ''[[Defender]]'' retreated, [[Anakin Skywalker]] came up with a plan to pilot the heavily damaged ''Defender'' into the Confederacy's flagship, while Ahsoka was left to take out the remaining enemy frigates. Ahsoka was still shaken from her earlier failure, but received support from [[Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]] and led the counterattack. R7 would then fly with Ahsoka in a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber]]. The attack was successful, and the [[Galactic Republic]] forces prepared to invade Ryloth and liberate the captive [[Twi'lek]] inhabitants from [[Techno Union]] leader [[Wat Tambor]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

Later, R7 accompanied Tano in her [[starfighter]] as she and Skywalker shot down the [[Hyena-class Droid Fighter/Bomber|''Hyena''-class Droid Bombers]] that had been ordered to destroy various Twi'lek villages by [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to show the galaxy the purported cost of a Republic victory.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

====Later battles====
During the beginning of the [[Battle of Umbara|campaign]] to retake the [[Expansion Region]] [[planet]] [[Umbara]], R7 again accompanied Tano when she flew into battle against the Separatist forces above the planet alongside her fellow [[Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee]] as they defended the landing of Republic forces, including the [[Cloning|clones]] of the [[501st Legion]] and the [[212th Attack Battalion]].<ref name="Darkness on Umbara">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref>

[[File:TanoRescuesMaster-S.jpg|right|thumb|281x281px|R7 piloting Tano's starfighter]]
R7 also flew in Tano's [[Ahsoka Tano's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor|newer]] [[Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class light interceptor]] when she accompanied her master Skywalker during the [[Defense of Cato Neimoidia|defense]] of [[Cato Neimoidia]]. When Skywalker's fighter was damaged by [[Pistoeka sabotage droid|buzz droids]] and he was knocked unconscious, Tano had R7 take control of her fighter while she leapt over to Skywalker's fighter to rescue him.<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref> Following the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombing]] of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] [[hangar]], Tano and Skywalker were recalled to [[Coruscant]]. Sometime after their arrival, R7 was seen traversing the Temple hallways.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>

===Order 66===
{{Quote|Careful! We're trying ''not'' to hurt him!|Ahsoka Tano to R7-A7 after the droid shocked a mind-controlled Rex unconscious|<ref name="Shattered" />}}
[[File:TeamAhsokaDroids-Shattered.png|left|thumb|274x274px|R7, G-G, and CH-33P agree to help Ahsoka]]
In the final [[Standard day|days]] of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> R7-A7 was stationed onboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Shattered" /> ''[[Tribunal]]'',<ref name="CWCE JtB" /> sent to [[Mandalore]] to aid Republic forces fighting in the [[Siege of Mandalore]]. Following the Republic's victory with the capture of the renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]], Tano and [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex]] returned to the [[Star Destroyer]], which jumped to [[hyperspace]] to deliver Maul to the [[Jedi High Council]] on Coruscant. However, with the [[Great Jedi Purge|execution]] of [[Order 66]] by [[Darth Sidious]], the [[clone trooper]]s turned on Tano. After [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|evading]] Rex, several [[Imperial shock trooper|shock troopers]], and the rest of the [[332nd Company]] aboard the ship, Tano managed to locate the room where R7-A7, as well as fellow [[astromech droid]]s [[CH-33P]] and [[RG-G1]], were being stored. Tano powered up R7, followed by Cheep and G-G, all of whom were distressed and confused by the clones' actions.<ref name="Shattered" />

Tano recruited the [[droid]]s to help her, which they were all eager to do. She ordered R7 to patch into the central [[computer]] to bring up all files related to the [[Death|late]] [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Fives]], based on a warning Rex had managed to give her before his programming took him over. The droid displayed the files to her, including profiles on Fives and the also deceased [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]] [[Tup]], as well as a recording of [[Kaminoan]] [[doctor]] [[Nala Se]] discussing an alleged malfunction in Fives' [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chip]]. Nala Se mentioned a grievance report filed by Rex in response to the situation, which Tano asked R7 to display. R7 told her that the report was sealed, but he was able to open the file after Tano had him use Anakin Skywalker's personal clearance code, 8108. Within the file, Rex discussed his concerns with the inhibitor chips possibly having a purpose not fully understood, leading Tano to the conclusion that the chips forced the clones to comply with Order 66 against their will.<ref name="Shattered" />

[[File:R7-A7_Rex_Hologram.png|thumb|right|200px|R7-A7 displaying the recording of Rex]]
Tano became determined to remove Rex's chip, formulating a plan to do so with the droids' help. R7 and Cheep managed to trap Rex between [[blast door]]s, isolating him from his troops. R7 then displayed a pre-recorded [[hologram]] of Ahsoka telling Rex that it was not his fault he had turned against her, and that she knew he was programmed through the inhibitor chip, offering to help him. In response, Rex aimed a [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|blaster pistol]] at R7, ordering him to reveal where Ahsoka was. Tano revealed that she was standing right behind Rex and spoke to him, causing him to turn around. With Rex distracted, R7 shocked him unconscious, and Tano chided him, reminding the droid that they were taking care not to hurt Rex.<ref name="Shattered" />

Tano and the three astromechs carried Rex to the [[medical bay]]. R7 ran a scan of Rex to look for the inhibitor chip within his brain, though nothing was found. Tano used [[the Force]] to look for the chip while touching Rex's head and chanting the [[Guardian's Mantra]], and the chip subsequently appeared in the scan. She ordered R7 to start the procedure to remove the inhibitor chip. R7 expressed his concerns to her about whether the procedure would work, but he started the procedure after she pointed out that they were dead anyways if it did not. With the clones attempting to break into the medical bay, R7 oversaw the surgery on Rex while Tano held off the attackers and the other droids worked on re-sealing the door.<ref name="Shattered" /> Following Rex's recovery, he and Ahsoka managed to stun the clones and escape the area, with R7 and the rest of the droids following Tano and Rex's lead. Tano then ordered R7 to find them a safe path out. R7 discovered that the [[escape pod]]s had been destroyed, leading the group to head for the ''Tribunal''{{'s}} hangar to find a [[shuttle]] and escape.<ref name="Victory and Death" />

As they sped towards the hangar, Maul, who had been freed from his imprisonment by Tano as a diversion, destroyed the Star Destroyer's [[hyperdrive]], knocking it out of hyperspace and destroying the ship's engines, allowing it to be caught in the gravitational pull of a nearby [[Unidentified moon|moon]]. Arriving at the hangar control room, the group captured it, with Tano and Rex stunning and knocking out all of the clones inside. Now controlling the hangar, Tano ordered R7 to open the doors of [[Bay 12]]. After discovering from G-G that the hyperdrive was gone, Tano changed her orders for R7, instead ordering the astromech to open the main hangar doors, revealing the nearing [[moon]] and leading Tano to declare that they needed to get off the ship.<ref name="Victory and Death" />

R7 then opened the bay doors, revealing a waiting [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]]. However, an army of clones waiting for their eventual arrival under the command of ARC trooper and [[Clone Lieutenant|Lieutenant]] [[Jesse]] merged from the other hangar bays and took positions in the middle of the hangar. As the clones got into formation, Tano came up with a plan for how they could reach the shuttle. Crouching down, Tano asked if she could count on the three droids, which they agreed she could. As Tano and Rex ran out of the control room, she informed the group that she would explain her plan on the way.<ref name="Victory and Death" />

[[File:R7A7destroyed-VaD.png|thumb|left|250px|R7-A7 was destroyed attempting to defend Tano.]]
As the clones remained in formation, Tano and Rex revealed themselves entering the hangar and asked the clones to hold their fire, feigning Tano's capture by Rex. As the droids sneaked past the clones, Rex unsuccessfully argued that the execution of Order 66 did not apply to Tano as she was no longer a member of the [[Jedi Order]], allowing the droids just enough time to drop the lifts beneath the clones, reducing the number of clones present and making an escape more manageable. Just then, Maul arrived in the hangar and ran past the droids in an effort to steal the shuttle for himself. Maul managed to [[Force push|push]] Tano into the hole from the lifts with [[the Force]], forcing G-G to use a cable to help her up. As Tano managed to make it back to the main hangar, Maul attempted to escape in the shuttle, but Tano [[Telekinesis|held]] the shuttle in place with the Force to prevent its departure. As she was focused on this, more clones arrived, which R7 noted in warning to Tano and Rex as they began to fire upon them. While Tano attempted to stop the shuttle from escaping, one of the clones' shots hit R7 in the head, deactivating him.<ref name="Victory and Death" />

After the battle ended with Rex and Tano's escape, the destruction of the ''Tribunal'' and the death of all the remaining clones onboard, as well as the destruction of Cheep and G-G, Tano and Rex retrieved what remained of R7 and placed his remains next to the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber|Y-wing]] they had stolen from the crashing Star Destroyer.<ref name="Victory and Death" />

===Imperial Era===
{{Quote|R7, we're ready for a pickup.|Trace Martez|<ref name="Decommissioned" />}}
R7 was rebuilt afterwards, and wound up in the company of [[Trace Martez|Trace]] and [[Rafa Martez]],<ref name="Decommissioned" /> two [[Martez family|sisters]] from the [[Coruscant Underworld]] whom Tano had met after leaving the Jedi Order.<ref name="Gone with a Trace">{{TCW|Gone with a Trace}}</ref> After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire]], the sisters worked as [[smuggler]]s aboard their [[Nebula-class freighter|freighter]], the ''[[Silver Angel]]'', taking jobs from people who opposed the Empire.<ref name="Decommissioned" /> [[Captain]] Rex<ref name="Battle Scars">{{TBB|Battle Scars}}</ref> asked the sisters to [[Mission to a droid decommissioning facility|steal]] the head of a [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|T-series tactical droid]] from a [[decommissioning facility]] on [[Corellia]], hoping to use the data to fight the new [[dictatorship]]. Arriving at [[Coronet City]], the sisters left R7 in charge of their [[starship]] so he could pick them up when they were ready, while they infiltrated the scrapping plant.<ref name="Decommissioned" />

However, the sisters' mission was complicated as they were not the only ones after the [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Corellia)|last remaining]] [[tactical droid]] at the facility: the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]], a group of rogue former [[clone commando]]s, had also snuck into the facility to steal it. After the facility was placed on lockdown due to the struggle between the two groups over the droid's head, they eventually worked together, reactivating [[battle droid]]s to fight the plant's [[police droid]]s to escape. Trace called R7 for a pickup, but shortly before the ''Silver Angel''{{'s}} arrival, the tactical droid head was destroyed by enemy [[blaster]] fire. When R7 arrived in the freighter, the sisters and clones boarded the ship and escaped. R7 flew the ship around before heading to the [[industrial dockyard]], where the clones had left their [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|own ship]]. After learning what the sisters' contact had wanted with the data, the clone leader [[Hunter]] gave Rafa a [[data rod]] with the copied data from the head, believing their cause was more worthy. Upon departing Corellia, Rafa had R7 call up Rex by hologram, telling him that their mission had been a success and further informing him of the rogue clones and [[Ord Mantell City|where]] to find them.<ref name="Decommissioned" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:R7-A7-SWZ.png|thumb|right|250px|R7-A7 served as Tano's loyal copilot and companion.]]
R7-A7, as Ahsoka Tano's personal astromech droid, was loyal to her personally as well as the Galactic Republic and Jedi Order.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> When Tano left the Jedi Order, she was deeply saddened to have to leave R7.<ref name="Build 48">{{BuildR2Cite|48|Droid Directory}}</ref> He remained loyal to Tano even after her departure from the Jedi, and immediately agreed to assist her in her flight from the clones after the issuance of Order 66.<ref name="Shattered" /> He was considered quite an aggressive droid in battle, and was particularly adept at plotting [[hyperspace route]]s and repairing Tano's ship.<ref name="SW:AEYNTK" /><ref name="Build 48" /> He possessed many unique personality quirks, such as a salute he delivered to Tano with his manipulator arm.<ref name="Shattered" />

R7 stood at 0.96 [[meter]]s, or 3 [[Foot|feet]], 2 inches tall,<ref name="CWCE JtB" /> with masculine programming.<ref name="SW:AEYNTK" /> R7 had mostly [[Color|red]] plating, with green highlights and a silver dome, as well as a light blue [[Photoreceptor|sensor]], a color scheme that matched<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> both of Tano's starfighters.<ref name="Sabotage" />

==Skills and abilities==
R7 was an astromech droid and was a skilled starfighter pilot, known for his maintenance of starfighters as well as repairs. He also was effective at information retrieval.<ref name="CWCE JtB" />

==Equipment==
R7-A7 assisted Tano in piloting both of her Jedi starfighters, the older Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> and her newer Eta-2 ''Actis''-class light interceptor.<ref name="Sabotage" /> While accompanying the Martez sisters, he was trusted to fly their [[freighter]], the ''Silver Angel'', by himself.<ref name="Decommissioned" /> R7 was equipped with a [[holoprojector]], [[scomp link]], manipulating arm, and a [[spark projector]].<ref name="Shattered" /> He also had onboard logic function displays.<ref name="CWCE JtB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:R7WardrobeMalfunction-Decommissioned.png|thumb|left|220px|R7 experienced a wardrobe malfunction in "Decommissioned."]]
R7-A7 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episode "[[Storm Over Ryloth]],"<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> which premiered on [[February 27]], [[2009]] on [[Cartoon Network]].<ref name="Storm Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> He was first [[canon]]ically identified by his full designation in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="SW:AEYNTK" />

In official images, R7 is depicted as having a white middle stabilizing leg, but in [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|season seven]] of ''The Clone Wars'', the leg is maroon, matching the rest of his body.<ref name="Shattered" /> The ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' episode "[[Decommissioned]]" depicts R7 with his normal red-green-silver plating in his first scene, but he is erroneously colored black-and-orange with a red sensor in his second,<ref name="Decommissioned" /> the same coloration as an [[Unidentified astromech droid (Saleucami)|Imperial astromech droid]] from the episode "[[Cut and Run]]" whose character model was repurposed from R7's.<ref name="Cut and Run EG">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/cut-and-run-episode-guide|text="Cut and Run" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] episode guide's Trivia gallery also mistakenly refers to R7-A7 as "A7-R7," his designated name in a different order.<ref name="Decommissioned episode guide">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/decommissioned-episode-guide|text="Decommissioned" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 5}}</ref>
